description:
Storyhouse is proud to introduce Spencer Place. The development comprises of a wide selection of Studio, 1 and 2 bedroom Apartments and Co-living Apartments. Your standard of living at Spencer Place is enhanced by the inclusion of on-site amenities, which include 24 hour on-site concierge, co-working and lounge facilities, a gym and areas that can be rented for private parties or events. Regular on-site resident events and gym classes will help you meet your neighbours' and settle into Spencer Place. These stylish new homes come fully furnished, with Virgin Media WiFi & TV package pre-enabled, and offer perfect convenience in the heart of Dublin City's Docklands. Simply turn the key and move in - and immediately enjoy the comfort and security that Spencer Place offers.
 
Positioned along the north bank of the River Liffey, Spencer Place lies at the core of the Dublin Docklands—minutes from the city centre by Luas, bus, bike, or even on foot. The surrounding neighborhood, often called Silicon Docks, is home to top-tier companies in finance and tech, including Google, Meta, PwC, and Salesforce. The area also has a local Fresh convenience store, Art of Coffee and much more.
 
NOTE: There are multiple unit types available in this development. The marketing material may not be of the exact unit available but are representative of the development rather than the exact specifications of the individual unit. The rent advertised represents the starting rent for these property types. Rents will vary throughout the development depending on the specific unit type. The overall BER Rating at this development is A Rated.
